data.situation:
After the farm visit, Lin and Maya returned to town by bus. Near the station, an old clock tower served as a landmark. They were locating the ferry pier on a paper map when a bus driver pointed across the square. Two paths ran beside the river; one would branch off towards the pier. The waiting shelter was on the far side of the road. Maya: That small bus has no driver at the front.
Driver: It’s an automated vehicle on a closed trial route today. The speedometer shows how fast it is moving. A supervisor is on board.
Lin: Is it replacing this bus?
Driver: Not today. The council’s mobility model includes walking, cycling and public transport. The leaflet by the stop explains the proposal. To the ferry pier
Cross at the lights and follow the riverside path. At the fork, take the path towards the water. Road congestion may delay buses this afternoon; please check the service board before leaving.

readingBlocks.en: After the farm visit, Lin and Maya returned to town by bus. Near the station, an old clock tower served as a landmark. They were locating the ferry pier on a paper map when a bus driver pointed across the square. Two paths ran beside the river; one would branch off towards the pier. The waiting shelter was on the far side of the road.
readingBlocks.zh: 参访农场后，林和玛雅乘公交回城。车站附近，一座老钟楼充当地标。她们正在纸地图上找渡口位置，一位公交司机指向广场对面。两条小路沿河而行，其中一条会岔向渡口。候车棚在马路另一侧。

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: That small bus has no driver at the front.
Driver: It’s an automated vehicle on a closed trial route today. The speedometer shows how fast it is moving. A supervisor is on board.
Lin: Is it replacing this bus?
Driver: Not today. The council’s mobility model includes walking, cycling and public transport. The leaflet by the stop explains the proposal.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：那辆小巴前面没有司机。
司机：那是一辆自动驾驶车辆，今天在封闭试行路线上运行。速度表显示行驶速度，有监督人员在车上。
林：它要替代这趟公交吗？
司机：今天不会。市政部门的出行模式方案包括步行、骑车和公共交通。车站旁的介绍页说明了提议。

readingBlocks.en:
To the ferry pier
Cross at the lights and follow the riverside path. At the fork, take the path towards the water. Road congestion may delay buses this afternoon; please check the service board before leaving.
readingBlocks.zh:
前往渡口
从信号灯处过马路，沿河边小路走。到分岔处，选靠水的路。今天下午道路拥堵可能延误公交；出发前请看班次牌。

glossary.zh: 易于辨认、帮助定位的地标
glossary.note: 可数名词，指辨认地点的建筑或物体；里程碑的比喻义另用语境。
glossary.example: The clock tower is a landmark near the station.
glossary.exampleZh: 钟楼是车站附近的一处地标。

externalEvidence.definition: the position of a prominent or well-known object in a particular landscape

glossary.note: locating为locate的-ing形式，这里作主语表示定位这一过程。
glossary.example: Locating the ferry pier takes a minute with the map.
glossary.exampleZh: 用地图找渡口位置需要一分钟。

externalEvidence.definition: a determination of the place where something is

glossary.note: 道路或路线branch off；不是树枝掉落。
glossary.example: One path branches off towards the pier.

glossary.note: the far side of something；本句以说话人位置为参照。
glossary.example: The shelter is on the far side of the road.

glossary.zh: 能自动执行驾驶任务的车辆
glossary.note: 本句为有监督的试行车辆；automated说明系统执行驾驶任务。
glossary.example: An automated vehicle is running on the trial route.
glossary.exampleZh: 一辆自动驾驶车辆正在试行路线上运行。

glossary.zh: 显示车辆速度的仪表；速度表
glossary.note: 可数名词；显示速度，不是里程表。
glossary.example: The speedometer shows how fast the bus is moving.
glossary.exampleZh: 速度表显示公交行驶得多快。

externalEvidence.definition: a meter fixed to a vehicle that measures and displays its speed

glossary.zh: 组织出行方式的模式或方案
glossary.note: 本句为地方交通规划的组合表达；不是所有学科中model都用这一意思。
glossary.example: The council’s mobility model includes walking and public transport.
glossary.exampleZh: 市政部门的出行模式方案包括步行和公共交通。

glossary.zh: 道路车辆过多造成的拥堵
glossary.note: 本句交通拥堵；与身体充血等医学用法分开。
glossary.example: Road congestion may delay the buses.
glossary.exampleZh: 道路拥堵可能延误公交。
